name: Stiegl Bräu
kurzbeschreibung:
**Discover the Timeless Tradition of Stiegl Bräu in Innsbruck**

Nestled in the heart of the **Alps**, **Innsbruck** invites you to experience one of **Tirol’s** most beloved beer traditions at **Stiegl Bräu**. Since 1891, this iconic brewery has been crafting award-winning **Tiroler Bier**—a perfect blend of crisp freshness and authentic Alpine flavor.

Step into the historic **Stiegl Brauerei** in the city center, where the aroma of freshly brewed beer and the charm of **Tirol’s** hospitality greet you. Here, you can savor **Stiegl’s** signature brews, including the smooth **Stiegl Radler** (a refreshing mix of beer and lemonade) and the robust **Stiegl Export**, all paired with hearty **Tiroler** specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn** or **Schlutzkrapfen**.

For beer enthusiasts, the **Stiegl Brauerei** offers guided tours, revealing the secrets behind this legendary brew. Whether you’re toasting in the cozy **Brauereigasthof** or exploring the scenic **Innsbrucker Bergbahnen** nearby, **Stiegl Bräu** promises an unforgettable taste of **Tirol’s** finest.

**Prost!** 🍻
